Button.transform: type->status, children->text, icon->leftIcon; no pure-icon buttons (all had text); 6 leftIcon Icons preserved for stage 3

Input.transform: Input.TextArea->@/shared/TextArea (onChange first param value); Input->@/shared/TextField (onChange(value), suffix kept, allowClear/size dropped)

Select.transform: ->@/shared/Select; options label->text, placeholder->defaultLabel, allowClear->enableClear, onChange(value) first-param; showSearch/optionFilterProp/size/status dropped

Radio.transform: Radio.Group->RadioGroup (default import @nce/eview-react/RadioGroup); children->data=[{text,value}]; isControlled; onChange compatible 2-arg write (a===form.cycle?b:a)

DatePicker.transform: RangePicker->DatePicker type=date range=[]; onChange(dateString,date,target) collects from/to into [dayjs,dayjs]; only writes back valid Date (avoids official anti-pattern)

Table.transform: dataSource->dataset, dataIndex->key, rowKey->hidden id column(display:false), pagination->enablePagination+enableAutoPaging+pagingProps, rowSelection->enableCheckBox+onRowCheck(indexes->ids via dataset), render 4th param row.rawData, allowSort:false on non-sorter cols, customSortFun preserves antd sorter logic (bandwidth mbps/price/etc), filters/onFilter dropped (no eview row-filter equivalent), scroll/fixed dropped (no freezeCol), maxHeight set

Tabs.transform: ->Tab/TabItem children-driven; activeKey(string)->selectedIndex(int) via TAB_KEYS map; onChange->onClick(index,title,event); draggable=false

Tag.transform: ->@/shared/Tag wrapper; call site keeps antd props (color/bordered) verbatim, wrapper maps color->token, bordered->fill

Tooltip.transform: ->TipBox type=simple wrapping; title->content; direction=bottom; trigger hover default

message.transform: ->declarative DivMessage via useNotice hook (createPortal to document.body, avoids eview input focus-loss); message.success->notify('success'), warning->'warn', info->'default'; templates-view uses local `message` shim object so Icon onClick call sites stay byte-identical

Dropdown.transform: no eview counterpart; handwrite src/components/dropdown (useState+click-outside+absolute menu); preserves menu.items data with <Icon name> icons verbatim; 4 instances (EXPORT_MENU, NOTICE_MENU, USER_MENU, ROW_MENU)

Progress.transform: no eview export; handwrite SimpleProgress (percent+CSS bar using --error/--success/--primary tokens); exception->error, normal->primary, success->success

unverifiedAtRuntime: Tab/TabItem import convention: used separate packages `@nce/eview-react/Tab` + `@nce/eview-react/TabItem` (per RadioGroup precedent that eview uses one-package-per-component).
